messages:
oliver: Quick sync 5 opened a PR to harmonize function/tool-calling examples and patch a set of broken anchors after the docs reorg: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5188
maya: Thanks! What are the explicit asks in the PR?
oliver: TL;DR: 1) choose a recommended payload wrapper shape (I propose `invocation_box`), 2) add tiny Python + Node snippets showing generate + parse compatibility helper, 3) sweep and fix stale anchors that are failing the site link-check.
cheng: I like `invocation_box` 1 neutral name and keeps room for later metadata fields. Can you show the schema you sketched?
oliver: Sure, tiny schema in the PR: ```{"type":"object","properties":{"invocation_box":{"type":"object","properties":{"cmd":{"type":"string"},"args":{"type":["object","array","null"]}},"required":["cmd"]}},"required":["invocation_box"]}```
sophia: LGTM. One extra note: some models emit null for lists (e.g., results: null). We should explicitly mention "treat null lists as empty" in the migration FAQ. That saves many parsing bugs.
maya: I'll add two compact snippets under docs/snippets/invocation_box: python.md and node.md. Each will show how to call the SDK, then call parseInvocationFallback() and handle both legacy flat and new wrapper shapes. Keep them razor-small.
cheng: For anchors: the build errors showed links like /docs/guides/function-calling#schema-quickref -> now redirects to /docs/guides/function-calling#schema-quickref-v2. I'll run a targeted grep to find hrefs that point to the old ids and map them to the stabilized kebab-case ids. Also will add a small assertion to the link-checker to fail PRs containing raw header punctuation.
oliver: Perfect. Proposed migration blurb (2 lines): "We recommend the compact invocation_box wrapper for forward compatibility. Use parseInvocationFallback() to accept both legacy flat responses and the new wrapper during rollout."
sophia: Fine by me. Can you also add a one-line compatibility snippet for naive parse code? Example: ```py
obj = parseInvocationFallback(resp.text)
box = obj.get('invocation_box') or { 'cmd': obj.get('cmd'), 'args': obj.get('args') }
```
maya: I'll add that exact snippet in both languages. Node variant will use optional chaining and null coalescing.
link-bot: Staging deploy: success 5 link-check job queued.
cheng: I'll wait for maya's push, run link-check locally, and open a tiny linkfix PR that updates the markdown and built HTML anchors. Estimated 35-50m.
oliver: Action items: maya -> snippets + README blurb; cheng -> anchor sweep + link-check tweak; sophia -> add nullable-list note in FAQ; oliver -> final review and merge once link-check is green.
maya: Pushing snippets in ~90m.
sophia: I'll add the FAQ line and a short example for handling null lists.
docs-bot: Reminder: link-check will block merges if unresolved anchors remain.
oliver: Thanks all. I'll merge after link-check green and snippets arrive. :thumbsup:
